items.question: Which paired lower limbs receive the sequential placement of ritual limb-mantras?
premises: The preceding instruction prescribes sequential placement of six aṅgas with paired syllables.
Specific body locations are named in paired form as sites of application.
The thighs, knees, and shanks are enumerated as successive paired locations.
items.inference: The ritual limb-mantras are to be placed in sequence on the pairs of thighs, knees, and shanks.
uncertainties: The exact mapping of each specific aṅga to each listed pair is not stated within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Likewise on the pair of thighs, on the pair of knees, and likewise on the pair of shanks.
